use_when: 机械设备
云台控制
目标跟踪
精密控制
如何获取当前连接的机械体设备（云台）列表并查询设备信息？
如何监听机械体设备的连接和断开状态变化？
如何启用或禁用摄像头目标跟踪功能实现人脸跟踪拍摄？
如何设置摄像头跟踪布局模式（默认、左侧、中间、右侧）？
如何监听跟踪状态变化事件（用户操作、布局变化等）？
如何实时获取机械体设备在三个轴向的当前角度？
如何查询设备在各轴向的最大旋转范围和旋转限制？
如何获取设备的最大旋转速度和连续旋转时间等运动参数？
如何开发基于云台的自动构图拍摄应用？
当您需要开发与云台等机械体设备交互的应用时，应使用Mechanic Kit
典型场景包括：物体跟踪拍摄（通过云台实现人脸跟踪和物体追踪，提升拍摄质量）、精准拍摄控制（操控云台进行精确的角度调整和运动轨迹控制）、以及设备状态监控（实时获取云台角度、旋转限制、运动参数等状态信息）
当您的应用需要集成第三方云台或其他机械体配件，实现自动化跟踪拍摄或远程操控功能时，也应使用Mechanic Kit来简化开发流程
获取已连接云台列表并显示设备型号与能力信息 / Get connected gimbal devices and show model and capability info
监听云台连接断开事件并自动刷新设备状态 / Listen for gimbal connect and disconnect events and refresh device state
实现云台三轴转动控制进行俯仰横滚偏航调节 / Implement 3-axis gimbal movement control for pitch roll and yaw adjustment
读取云台当前角度并在界面实时显示姿态数据 / Read current gimbal angles and display live orientation data in the UI
查询云台各轴旋转范围限位和最大速度参数 / Query per-axis rotation limits and maximum speed parameters of the gimbal
控制云台按指定方向和速度持续旋转 / Drive the gimbal to rotate continuously in a specified direction and speed
启用目标跟踪让云台自动跟随人脸或主体 / Enable target tracking so the gimbal automatically follows a face or subject
切换云台自动跟踪构图位置到左中右布局 / Switch gimbal auto-tracking composition to left center or right framing
订阅跟踪状态变化并处理用户接管或目标丢失 / Subscribe to tracking state changes and handle user takeover or target loss
开发自动构图拍摄功能让云台自动调整镜头朝向 / Build auto-framing capture so the gimbal automatically adjusts camera direction
根据机械体运动能力限制设置安全的控制指令 / Apply safe control commands based on the device motion capability limits
管理机械体设备会话并在重连后恢复控制 / Manage mechanical device sessions and restore control after reconnection
do_not_use_when: 需求是读取通用传感器数据（如加速度计、陀螺仪、环境传感器）而不是控制云台等机械体设备时，应使用 sensor-service-kit / If the task is to read general sensor data (such as accelerometer, gyroscope, or environmental sensors) rather than control gimbals or other mechanical devices, use sensor-service-kit
需求是处理触摸、按键、鼠标等通用输入事件而非机械体蓝牙控制与跟踪时，应使用 input-kit / If the task is to handle general input events like touch, key, or mouse instead of mechanical Bluetooth control and tracking, use input-kit
需求是输入法开发、软键盘能力或文本输入框架集成时，应使用 ime-kit / If the task is IME development, soft keyboard capability, or text input framework integration, use ime-kit
需求是手写笔事件、压感、悬停或笔迹能力而非云台/机械体控制时，应使用 pen-kit / If the task is stylus events, pressure, hover, or ink capabilities rather than gimbal/mechanic control, use pen-kit

需求是开发硬件驱动、适配底层设备协议或内核级接入而不是调用上层机械体控制API时，应使用 driver-development-kit / If the task is to develop hardware drivers, adapt low-level device protocols, or perform kernel-level integration instead of calling high-level mechanic control APIs, use driver-development-kit

需求是处理游戏手柄按键、摇杆、震动等控制器能力而非机械体设备操控时，应使用 game-controller-kit / If the task is to handle game controller buttons, sticks, vibration, or related controller features rather than mechanic device operation, use game-controller-kit
preconditions: 目标设备与应用运行环境支持 API version 20 及以上并提供 Mechanic Kit 能力 / The target device and app runtime support API version 20 or later and provide Mechanic Kit capability
待控制的机械体设备已按 Mechanic Kit 协议标准接入并与终端建立正常蓝牙连接 / The mechanic device to be controlled conforms to the Mechanic Kit protocol and has a healthy Bluetooth connection with the terminal
如需目标跟踪，开发设备相机驱动具备人脸检测能力且相机服务可用 / For target tracking, the device camera driver supports face detection and the camera service is available
应用已在工程配置中声明并获得蓝牙及相关设备访问所需权限（如系统版本要求） / The app has declared and obtained required Bluetooth and related device-access permissions in project configuration as required by the system version
inputs: 机械体设备标识或设备对象 / mechanic device identifier or device object
跟踪控制参数（启停、目标类型、布局模式） / tracking control parameters (enable/disable, target type, layout mode)
角度或运动控制参数 / angle or motion control parameters
状态监听回调或事件订阅对象 / state listener callback or event subscription object

postconditions.statement: 代码已通过 Mechanic Kit API 实现至少一种机械体能力：设备连接查询/监听、目标跟踪控制、布局设置或状态读取 / The code uses Mechanic Kit APIs to implement at least one mechanic capability: device connection query/listening, tracking control, layout setting, or state reading
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the agent's edit set clearly add or modify code that calls Mechanic Kit APIs for mechanic device management, tracking, layout, or status access?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及目标跟踪，代码中已显式设置跟踪开关、跟踪布局或跟踪状态监听中的至少一项 / If target tracking is involved, the code explicitly configures at least one of tracking enablement, tracking layout, or tracking state listening
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the requested feature includes target tracking, do the edits explicitly add code for enabling/disabling tracking, setting a tracking layout, or subscribing to tracking state changes?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及设备状态能力，代码中已添加对设备连接状态、三轴角度、旋转限制或运动参数的查询/监听逻辑 / If device status capability is involved, the code adds query or listener logic for connection state, three-axis angles, rotation limits, or motion parameters
postconditions.judge_prompt: When the task concerns device status, do the edits include logic to query or listen for connection state, axis angles, rotation limits, or motion parameters?
